prompt: Several jobs in one workflow file repeat the same three steps. Which feature collapses the duplication — and what is its reach?
explanation: An anchor (`&name`) marks a block once and an alias (`*name`) expands it again — inside a single file, which is exactly the fix for repeated steps. Crossing files or repositories needs reusable workflows or composite actions, because anchors never leave their document.

options.text: A reusable workflow — usable across files and repositories
A composite action — usable across repositories once published
A workflow template — copied into each repository
YAML anchors and aliases — but only inside that one file
